set -e

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
export PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1

sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
  git build-essential python3-pip python3-venv ca-certificates

PYTHON_BIN="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)"
WORKDIR="$(mktemp -d)"
REPO_DIR="$WORKDIR/requests"
VENV_DIR="$WORKDIR/venv"

git clone -c fetch.fsck.badTimezone=ignore \
  --depth 1 \
  https://github.com/psf/requests.git \
  "$REPO_DIR"

"$PYTHON_BIN" -m venv "$VENV_DIR"
. "$VENV_DIR/bin/activate"

python -m pip install -q --upgrade pip
python -m pip install -q "$REPO_DIR"

cd "$WORKDIR"
python -c 'import requests; assert requests.__version__; print(requests.__version__)'

echo REPRO_OK
